Union Minister Amit Shah announces Uniform Civil Code push in 21 states

Union Home Minister Amit Shah stated that governments led by the BJP-NDA coalition in 21 states plan to introduce a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) before the 2029 general elections. The announcement was made by Shah, indicating a significant push for the implementation of the UCC across these states. The Uniform Civil Code aims to standardize personal laws for all citizens, regardless of religion.
